The zeta potentials of PS and PLA suspended in deionized water were -2.87 ± 0.68 and -1.80 ± 0.45 mV, respectively. || The zeta potential was measured by a nanoparticle zeta potential meter (Litesizer 500, Anton Paar, Graz, Austria) equipped with a 658 nm wavelength laser source, and the applied voltage was kept at 200 V.
